primaryTextChecks.text: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.
primaryTextChecks.decision: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.

primaryTextChecks.text: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
